spec.description: Production only. Adoption of Kura, the per-account cache mesh, now that the CLI enables it by default (4.207.0-canary.15+). CLI-run panels cover the module cache lane; the per-lane row compares module, Xcode compilation cache and Gradle traffic on the same route families in Prometheus, with REAPI as a Kura-only lane. Splits hosted cache traffic between Kura (*.kura.tuist.dev) and the legacy hosted cache (cache-*.tuist.dev) using ClickHouse command_events.cache_endpoint, kura_usage_events and cas_events_daily_stats, the Postgres kura_servers / kura_origin_rollups tables, and the live kura_* / cache_* Prometheus series.

spec.title: Kura share of module cache runs
spec.description: Module (binary) cache lane only. Share of CLI runs (`generate`, `test`, `cache`, `run`, `warm`) whose resolved module cache endpoint was a Kura instance (`*.kura.tuist.dev`) rather than the legacy hosted cache (`cache-*.tuist.dev`) or a self-hosted endpoint. From ClickHouse `command_events.cache_endpoint`, weighted by invocation. The Xcode compilation cache, Gradle and REAPI lanes are not in command events; see the per-lane row.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT round(100 * countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') / count(), 1) AS "Kura share"
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''

spec.title: Projects by module cache backend
spec.description: Module cache lane only. Distinct projects with at least one cache run against each backend in the range. "Both" is the overlap: projects that reached Kura and the legacy hosted cache in the same range (mid-migration, or a mix of CLI versions).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AS "Kura",
  uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev') AS "Legacy hosted cache",
  uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') + uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev') - uniqExactIf(project_id, (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') OR (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS "Both",
  uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint != '' AND NOT (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AND NOT (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS "Self-hosted / custom"
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''

spec.title: Accounts asking for Kura
spec.description: Accounts whose CLI asked the server for a Kura endpoint (`demand_count`) versus accounts with any cache run (`run_count`), from Postgres `kura_origin_rollups` over the range. A Kura-default CLI (4.207.0-canary.15+) always asks, so this is the account-level adoption of the new default. Rollups start on 2026-08-31.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT account_id) FILTER (WHERE demand_count > 0) AS "Asking for Kura",
  count(DISTINCT account_id) AS "With cache runs",
  round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT account_id) FILTER (WHERE demand_count > 0) / NULLIF(count(DISTINCT account_id), 0), 1) AS "Share %"
FROM public.kura_origin_rollups
WHERE date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date

spec.title: Accounts with a live Kura instance
spec.description: Accounts that own at least one Kura instance not destroyed/failed (statuses provisioning, active, replicating, drain_pending, archived), from Postgres `kura_servers`. Instances are demand-provisioned, so this grows as Kura-default CLIs reach new accounts.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT account_id) AS "Accounts", count(*) AS "Instances"
FROM public.kura_servers WHERE status NOT IN (2, 3, 4)

spec.title: Kura tenants serving now
spec.description: Distinct `tenant_id` values (account handles) currently exported by `kura_node_info` in the production cluster.

spec.title: Cache runs from Kura-default CLI
spec.description: Share of cache runs coming from a CLI version that enables Kura by default (4.207.0-canary.15 and later). Runs from older CLIs only reach Kura through an explicit opt-in.

spec.rawSql:
WITH splitByChar('-', tuist_version) AS ver_parts,
  splitByChar('.', ver_parts[1]) AS core,
  toUInt32OrZero(core[1]) AS v_major,
  toUInt32OrZero(core[2]) AS v_minor,
  ver_parts[2] AS pre,
  toUInt32OrZero(splitByChar('.', pre)[2]) AS pre_n,
  (v_major > 4) OR (v_major = 4 AND v_minor > 207)
    OR (v_major = 4 AND v_minor = 207 AND (pre = '' OR NOT startsWith(pre, 'canary') OR pre_n >= 15)) AS kura_default
SELECT round(100 * countIf(kura_default) / count(), 1) AS "Kura-default CLI share"
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''

spec.title: Explicit Kura opt-ins
spec.description: Accounts with an active `account_cache_endpoints` row of technology `kura`, i.e. the pre-default opt-in path. These accounts were on Kura before the CLI default flipped.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT account_id) AS "Opted-in accounts"
FROM public.account_cache_endpoints WHERE technology = 1 AND deactivated_at IS NULL

spec.title: Module cache runs by backend
spec.description: Module cache lane only: CLI runs that reported a module cache endpoint, split by where the traffic went. From ClickHouse `command_events`.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(ran_at, INTERVAL 1 $bucket) AS time,
  countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AS "Kura",
  countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev') AS "Legacy hosted cache",
  countIf(cache_endpoint != '' AND NOT (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AND NOT (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS "Self-hosted / custom"
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Kura share of module cache runs over time
spec.description: Module cache lane only. Percentage of hosted module cache runs (Kura + legacy hosted cache) that went to Kura per bucket. Self-hosted endpoints are excluded from the denominator since they are not part of the migration.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(ran_at, INTERVAL 1 $bucket) AS time,
  round(100 * countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') / countIf((cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') OR (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')), 2) AS "Kura share"
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Projects by module cache backend
spec.description: Module cache lane only. Distinct projects with cache runs per bucket against Kura, against the legacy hosted cache, and against both in the same bucket.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT toStartOfInterval(ran_at, INTERVAL 1 $bucket) AS time,
  uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AS "Kura",
  uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev') AS "Legacy hosted cache",
  uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') + uniqExactIf(project_id, cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev') - uniqExactIf(project_id, (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') OR (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS "Both"
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Accounts: cache runs vs asking for Kura vs Kura transfers
spec.description: Per day: accounts with any cache run and accounts whose CLI asked for a Kura endpoint (Postgres `kura_origin_rollups`, from 2026-08-31), plus accounts with real Kura transfers (ClickHouse `kura_usage_events`). The gap between "asking" and "transfers" is accounts whose instance is still provisioning or that fell back to the legacy cache.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT date::timestamptz AS time,
  count(DISTINCT account_id) AS "With cache runs",
  count(DISTINCT account_id) FILTER (WHERE demand_count > 0) AS "Asking for Kura"
FROM public.kura_origin_rollups
WHERE date BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::date AND $__timeTo()::date
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT toStartOfInterval(window_start, INTERVAL 1 day) AS time,
  uniqExact(account_id) AS "With Kura transfers"
FROM kura_usage_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Accounts with a live Kura instance (cumulative)
spec.description: Accounts that currently own a non-destroyed Kura instance, accumulated by the day their first instance was provisioned. From Postgres `kura_servers`.

spec.rawSql:
WITH live_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id, min(inserted_at) AS first_at FROM public.kura_servers WHERE status NOT IN (2, 3, 4) GROUP BY account_id
), daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', first_at) AS time, count(*) AS new_accounts FROM live_accounts GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT time, new_accounts AS "New accounts", sum(new_accounts) OVER (ORDER BY time)::bigint AS "Accounts with an instance"
FROM daily WHERE time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

spec.title: Cache runs by CLI capability
spec.description: Kura-default CLI is 4.207.0-canary.15+. "Kura-default CLI, legacy endpoint" is the migration lag: a capable CLI that still hit the legacy hosted cache, either because the account's instance was still provisioning (the server hands back the legacy endpoints meanwhile) or because TUIST_FEATURE_FLAG_KURA was turned off.

spec.rawSql:
WITH splitByChar('-', tuist_version) AS ver_parts,
  splitByChar('.', ver_parts[1]) AS core,
  toUInt32OrZero(core[1]) AS v_major,
  toUInt32OrZero(core[2]) AS v_minor,
  ver_parts[2] AS pre,
  toUInt32OrZero(splitByChar('.', pre)[2]) AS pre_n,
  (v_major > 4) OR (v_major = 4 AND v_minor > 207)
    OR (v_major = 4 AND v_minor = 207 AND (pre = '' OR NOT startsWith(pre, 'canary') OR pre_n >= 15)) AS kura_default
SELECT toStartOfInterval(ran_at, INTERVAL 1 $bucket) AS time,
  countIf(kura_default AND (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev')) AS "Kura-default CLI, Kura endpoint",
  countIf(kura_default AND (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS "Kura-default CLI, legacy endpoint",
  countIf(NOT kura_default AND (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev')) AS "Older CLI, Kura endpoint (opt-in)",
  countIf(NOT kura_default AND (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS "Older CLI, legacy endpoint"
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Kura share per cache lane
spec.description: Share of `/api/cache/*` requests served by production Kura nodes rather than the production legacy cache service, per lane, over the selected range. Lanes are the route families both backends expose: module cache (`/api/cache/module/*`), Xcode compilation cache (`/api/cache/cas/*` and `/api/cache/keyvalue*`), Gradle (`/api/cache/gradle/*`). REAPI is gRPC and Kura-only, so it has no share to show.

spec.title: Kura share per cache lane over time
spec.description: Kura requests over Kura + legacy requests on each lane's route family, from Prometheus. Gaps mean neither backend saw traffic on that lane in the interval.

spec.title: Module lane request rate by backend
spec.description: Requests per second on `/api/cache/module.*` routes: production Kura nodes versus production legacy cache service instances (canary and staging excluded by instance name).

spec.title: Xcode lane request rate by backend
spec.description: Requests per second on `/api/cache/(cas|keyvalue).*` routes: production Kura nodes versus production legacy cache service instances (canary and staging excluded by instance name).

spec.title: Gradle lane request rate by backend
spec.description: Requests per second on `/api/cache/gradle.*` routes: production Kura nodes versus production legacy cache service instances (canary and staging excluded by instance name).

spec.title: Cache bytes by lane and backend
spec.description: Kura bytes per lane from `kura_usage_events` (rollups pushed by managed nodes). Legacy bytes exist in ClickHouse for the Xcode compilation cache (`cas_events_daily_stats`, daily) and Gradle (`gradle_cache_events`); the legacy module cache only records events in Postgres `cache_events`, which is too large to scan from Grafana, so that series is absent and the module lane is Kura-only here. REAPI has no legacy counterpart.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time,
  sum(kura_module) AS "Kura · Module", sum(kura_xcode) AS "Kura · Xcode", sum(kura_gradle) AS "Kura · Gradle", sum(kura_reapi) AS "Kura · REAPI",
  sum(legacy_xcode) AS "Legacy · Xcode", sum(legacy_gradle) AS "Legacy · Gradle"
FROM (
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(window_start, INTERVAL 1 $bucket) AS time,
    sumIf(bytes, artifact_kind = 'module') AS kura_module, sumIf(bytes, artifact_kind = 'xcode') AS kura_xcode,
    sumIf(bytes, artifact_kind = 'gradle') AS kura_gradle, sumIf(bytes, artifact_kind = 'reapi') AS kura_reapi,
    toUInt64(0) AS legacy_xcode, toUInt64(0) AS legacy_gradle
  FROM kura_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(toDateTime(date), INTERVAL 1 $bucket) AS time,
    toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(sum(total_size)), toUInt64(0)
  FROM cas_events_daily_stats WHERE date BETWEEN toDate(toDateTime(intDiv($__from, 1000))) AND toDate(toDateTime(intDiv($__to, 1000))) GROUP BY time
  UNION ALL
  SELECT toStartOfInterval(inserted_at, INTERVAL 1 $bucket) AS time,
    toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(0), toUInt64(sum(size))
  FROM gradle_cache_events WHERE $__timeFilter(inserted_at) GROUP BY time
)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

spec.title: Kura usage by account and lane
spec.description: Requests and bytes each account pushed through Kura per lane in the range, from `kura_usage_events` joined to the Postgres accounts table. Shows which lanes an account has actually moved, not just whether it has an instance.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT account_id, artifact_kind AS lane, sum(request_count) AS requests, sum(bytes) AS bytes, max(window_start) AS last_seen
FROM kura_usage_events WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)
GROUP BY account_id, lane ORDER BY requests DESC
SELECT id AS account_id, name AS account_handle FROM public.accounts

spec.title: Live cache request rate by backend
spec.description: Requests per second on the `/api/cache/*` routes: the production legacy cache service instances (`cache_prom_ex_phoenix_http_requests_total`, canary and staging instances excluded since that series has no cluster label) versus every production Kura node (`kura_http_requests_total_total{cluster="tuist-production"}`). Prometheus, so this is the real-time view the ClickHouse panels lag behind.

spec.title: Kura request rate per tenant
spec.description: `/api/cache/*` requests per second on production Kura nodes, attributed to the tenant (account handle) through `kura_node_info`.

spec.expr: sum by (tenant_id) (sum by (cluster, pod) (rate(kura_http_requests_total_total{cluster="tuist-production", route=~"/api/cache/.*"}[$__rate_interval])) * on (cluster, pod) group_left(tenant_id) max by (cluster, pod, tenant_id) (kura_node_info{cluster="tuist-production"}))

spec.title: Account migration status
spec.description: Every account with hosted cache runs in the range, rolled up from ClickHouse `command_events` per project and joined to the Postgres account map. Kura share is Kura runs over Kura + legacy runs: 0% = still fully on the legacy cache, 100% = fully migrated, anything in between = using both.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT project_id,
  countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AS kura_runs,
  countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev') AS legacy_runs,
  countIf(cache_endpoint != '' AND NOT (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AND NOT (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS other_runs,
  nullIf(maxIf(ran_at, cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev'), toDateTime64('1970-01-01 00:00:00', 6)) AS last_kura_run,
  nullIf(maxIf(ran_at, cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev'), toDateTime64('1970-01-01 00:00:00', 6)) AS last_legacy_run
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''
GROUP BY project_id

SELECT p.id AS project_id, a.name AS account_handle,
  CASE WHEN a.organization_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Organization' ELSE 'Individual' END AS account_type
FROM public.projects p JOIN public.accounts a ON p.account_id = a.id

spec.title: Accounts using both backends
spec.description: Accounts that had runs against Kura and against the legacy hosted cache in the same range. Expected while an account rolls out a Kura-default CLI across machines and CI; an account stuck here for long has a mix of CLI versions or an explicit opt-out somewhere.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT project_id,
  countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AS kura_runs,
  countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev') AS legacy_runs,
  countIf(cache_endpoint != '' AND NOT (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev') AND NOT (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS other_runs,
  nullIf(maxIf(ran_at, cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev'), toDateTime64('1970-01-01 00:00:00', 6)) AS last_kura_run,
  nullIf(maxIf(ran_at, cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev'), toDateTime64('1970-01-01 00:00:00', 6)) AS last_legacy_run
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''
GROUP BY project_id

SELECT p.id AS project_id, a.name AS account_handle,
  CASE WHEN a.organization_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Organization' ELSE 'Individual' END AS account_type
FROM public.projects p JOIN public.accounts a ON p.account_id = a.id

spec.title: Kura-default CLI still hitting the legacy cache
spec.description: Projects where a Kura-default CLI (4.207.0-canary.15+) reported the legacy hosted cache as its endpoint in the range. The server answers a Kura-capable client with the legacy endpoints while the account's instance is still provisioning, so a project that stays here after its instance is active means TUIST_FEATURE_FLAG_KURA is disabled on that machine or the resolved endpoint was cached for the hour.

spec.rawSql:
WITH splitByChar('-', tuist_version) AS ver_parts,
  splitByChar('.', ver_parts[1]) AS core,
  toUInt32OrZero(core[1]) AS v_major,
  toUInt32OrZero(core[2]) AS v_minor,
  ver_parts[2] AS pre,
  toUInt32OrZero(splitByChar('.', pre)[2]) AS pre_n,
  (v_major > 4) OR (v_major = 4 AND v_minor > 207)
    OR (v_major = 4 AND v_minor = 207 AND (pre = '' OR NOT startsWith(pre, 'canary') OR pre_n >= 15)) AS kura_default
SELECT project_id,
  countIf(kura_default AND (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS lagging_runs,
  countIf(kura_default AND (cache_endpoint LIKE '%.kura.tuist.dev')) AS kura_runs,
  maxIf(ran_at, kura_default AND (cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev')) AS last_lagging_run,
  argMax(tuist_version, ran_at) AS latest_cli
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''
GROUP BY project_id
HAVING lagging_runs > 0
ORDER BY lagging_runs DESC

SELECT p.id AS project_id, a.name AS account_handle,
  CASE WHEN a.organization_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Organization' ELSE 'Individual' END AS account_type
FROM public.projects p JOIN public.accounts a ON p.account_id = a.id

spec.title: Legacy cache users blocked by an older CLI
spec.description: Projects on the legacy hosted cache whose most recent run came from a CLI older than 4.207.0-canary.15, so the Kura default does not apply to them yet. This is the population the migration depends on upgrading. Sorted by legacy runs.

spec.rawSql:
WITH splitByChar('-', tuist_version) AS ver_parts,
  splitByChar('.', ver_parts[1]) AS core,
  toUInt32OrZero(core[1]) AS v_major,
  toUInt32OrZero(core[2]) AS v_minor,
  ver_parts[2] AS pre,
  toUInt32OrZero(splitByChar('.', pre)[2]) AS pre_n,
  (v_major > 4) OR (v_major = 4 AND v_minor > 207)
    OR (v_major = 4 AND v_minor = 207 AND (pre = '' OR NOT startsWith(pre, 'canary') OR pre_n >= 15)) AS kura_default
SELECT project_id,
  countIf(cache_endpoint LIKE 'https://cache-%.tuist.dev') AS legacy_runs,
  argMax(tuist_version, ran_at) AS latest_cli,
  argMax(kura_default, ran_at) AS latest_is_kura_default,
  max(ran_at) AS last_run
FROM command_events
WHERE $__timeFilter(ran_at) AND cache_endpoint != ''
GROUP BY project_id
HAVING legacy_runs > 0 AND latest_is_kura_default = 0
ORDER BY legacy_runs DESC

SELECT p.id AS project_id, a.name AS account_handle,
  CASE WHEN a.organization_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Organization' ELSE 'Individual' END AS account_type
FROM public.projects p JOIN public.accounts a ON p.account_id = a.id

spec.title: Kura instances
spec.description: Every non-destroyed Kura instance from Postgres `kura_servers`, with the account, whether the account opted in explicitly before the default flip, and the demand-driven lifecycle state (`kura_account_region_lifecycles`).

spec.rawSql:
SELECT a.name AS account_handle, s.region, CASE s.status WHEN 0 THEN 'provisioning' WHEN 1 THEN 'active' WHEN 2 THEN 'failed'
  WHEN 3 THEN 'destroying' WHEN 4 THEN 'destroyed' WHEN 5 THEN 'replicating'
  WHEN 6 THEN 'drain_pending' WHEN 7 THEN 'archived' END AS status, s.url, s.current_image_tag AS image_tag,
  s.inserted_at AS provisioned_at, s.last_ready_at,
  (ace.id IS NOT NULL) AS explicit_opt_in, l.keep_warm, l.last_cache_demand_at, l.archived_at
FROM public.kura_servers s
JOIN public.accounts a ON a.id = s.account_id
LEFT JOIN public.account_cache_endpoints ace ON ace.account_id = s.account_id AND ace.technology = 1 AND ace.deactivated_at IS NULL
LEFT JOIN public.kura_account_region_lifecycles l ON l.account_id = s.account_id AND l.service_region = s.region
WHERE s.status NOT IN (2, 3, 4)
ORDER BY s.inserted_at DESC
